description: One project profile, stored at profiles/<name>.json. Selects sources by id and topic, filters items by keyword and caps the daily digest.

exclude_keywords.description: Lowercase words or phrases; an item matching any of these is dropped even when it matches an include keyword.

include_keywords.description: Lowercase words or phrases matched on word boundaries against title and summary. Empty means every item from the selected sources.

sources.description: Source ids included regardless of topic.

topic_keywords.description: Optional map of topic or topic/subtopic id to the keywords that tag an item with it.

topics.description: topic or topic/subtopic ids from schema/topics.json; every enabled source carrying one of them is included.

title: Project profile
